title: HP TET JBT · July 2021 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET JBT exam of the June 2021 session (held 9 July 2021), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper: garbled or doubtful questions were left out.

questions.text: Which of the following methods is considered the most scientific and objective method of studying behaviour?
questions.textHi: व्यवहार के अध्ययन की कौन-सी विधि सबसे अधिक वैज्ञानिक और वस्तुनिष्ठ मानी जाती है?
questions.explanation: The experimental method controls variables and tests cause and effect, making it the most scientific and objective. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: How many stages of psychosocial development did Erikson describe?
questions.textHi: एरिक्सन ने मनोसामाजिक विकास की कितनी अवस्थाएँ बताईं?
questions.explanation: Erikson described eight psychosocial stages from infancy to old age. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Our genes are composed of
questions.textHi: हमारे जीन किससे बने होते हैं?
questions.explanation: Genes are segments of DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid). (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Each egg cell (ovum) carries which sex chromosome?
questions.textHi: प्रत्येक अंड कोशिका में कौन-सा लिंग गुणसूत्र होता है?
questions.explanation: Every ovum carries an X chromosome; the sperm carries either X or Y. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Delinquency is often associated with
questions.textHi: बाल अपराध प्रायः किससे जुड़ा होता है?
questions.explanation: Low parental support, faulty discipline and family discord are all linked with juvenile delinquency. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Prenatal development is commonly divided into periods called
questions.textHi: जन्म-पूर्व विकास को सामान्यतः किन अवधियों में बाँटा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Prenatal development has three periods: germinal, embryonic and fetal. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The process of ........ is important in personality development.
questions.textHi: व्यक्तित्व विकास में ........ की प्रक्रिया महत्वपूर्ण है।
questions.explanation: Through identification (with parents and models) the child takes on values and traits, shaping personality. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Skinner conducted his studies on
questions.textHi: स्किनर ने अपने अध्ययन किन पर किए?
questions.explanation: B.F. Skinner experimented mainly with rats and pigeons in the Skinner box. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: In operant conditioning, the procedure of not reinforcing a response is called
questions.textHi: क्रियाप्रसूत अनुबंधन में किसी अनुक्रिया को पुनर्बलित न करने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है
questions.explanation: Withholding reinforcement so that a response fades is called extinction. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Which of the following is a system of memory?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी स्मृति की प्रणाली है?
questions.explanation: Memory systems are sensory, short-term and long-term memory (Atkinson-Shiffrin model). (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The first stage of memory is
questions.textHi: स्मृति की पहली अवस्था है
questions.explanation: Memory stages are encoding, storage and retrieval; encoding comes first. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Partial or complete loss of Memory is called :
questions.textHi: स्मृति का आंशिक या पूर्ण लोप कहलाता है
questions.explanation: Amnesia is partial or complete loss of memory. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Which mental activities are involved in thinking?
questions.textHi: चिंतन में कौन-सी मानसिक क्रियाएँ शामिल होती हैं?
questions.explanation: Thinking involves inferring, abstracting and reasoning. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Mentally retarded people with IQ ranging from 25 to 39 are known as
questions.textHi: जिन मंदबुद्धि व्यक्तियों की बुद्धि-लब्धि 25 से 39 के बीच होती है, वे कहलाते हैं
questions.explanation: On the Wechsler classification, IQ 25–39 is severe mental retardation. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The propounder of the Insight theory of learning is
questions.textHi: अधिगम के अंतर्दृष्टि सिद्धांत के प्रतिपादक हैं
questions.explanation: Wolfgang Köhler proposed insight learning from his experiments with chimpanzees. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: How many personality types were described by Kretschmer?
questions.textHi: क्रेचमर ने व्यक्तित्व के कितने प्रकार बताए?
questions.explanation: Kretschmer gave three body-build types: pyknic, athletic and asthenic (leptosomic). (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Creativity is identified by
questions.textHi: सृजनात्मकता की पहचान होती है
questions.explanation: Creativity is recognised by new, original results or products. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Who said, "Creativity is essentially found in new construction or production"?
questions.textHi: यह किसने कहा: "सृजनात्मकता मुख्यतः नवीन रचना या उत्पादन में होती है"?
questions.explanation: James Drever: "Creativity is essentially found in new construction or production." (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Who propounded the laws of learning?
questions.textHi: अधिगम के नियमों के प्रतिपादक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: E.L. Thorndike gave the laws of learning: readiness, exercise and effect. (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Children whose mental age is lower than their chronological age are known as :
questions.textHi: जिन बच्चों की मानसिक आयु उनकी कालानुक्रमिक आयु से कम होती है, वे कहलाते हैं
questions.explanation: When mental age is below chronological age (IQ below normal) the child is called mentally retarded. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Who stated, "Children construct their own understanding through interaction with their environment"?
questions.textHi: किसने कहा, "बच्चे अपने वातावरण के साथ अंतःक्रिया द्वारा अपनी समझ का निर्माण स्वयं करते हैं।"
questions.explanation: Piaget's constructivism holds that children build understanding by interacting with the environment. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: What is the IQ of a child whose mental age equals the chronological age?
questions.textHi: जिस बालक की मानसिक आयु उसकी कालानुक्रमिक आयु के बराबर हो, उसकी बुद्धि-लब्धि कितनी होगी?
questions.explanation: IQ = (MA/CA) × 100 = 100 when MA equals CA. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The stage in which a child begins to think logically about concrete objects and events is known as
questions.textHi: वह अवस्था जिसमें बच्चा मूर्त वस्तुओं और घटनाओं के बारे में तार्किक रूप से सोचना शुरू करता है, कहलाती है
questions.explanation: In the concrete operational stage (7–11 years) children reason logically about concrete objects and events. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The Kindergarten system of education was proposed by
questions.textHi: शिक्षा की किंडरगार्टन पद्धति का प्रतिपादन किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Friedrich Froebel founded the Kindergarten system. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Ceylon is ........ island.
questions.explanation: 'Island' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: ........ a Ford, he has a Fiat car.
questions.explanation: 'Besides' means 'in addition to': besides a Ford, he has a Fiat. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: He and ........ were good friends.
questions.explanation: The subject of a verb takes the subjective case 'I'. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The synonym of 'Agony' is
questions.explanation: Agony means severe pain or suffering. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The masculine of 'Heifer' is
questions.explanation: A heifer is a young cow; the masculine given in grammar books is bullock. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: The word 'Amateur' means
options: one who does some art or sport as a hobby
one who is not mature enough
questions.explanation: An amateur does an art or sport as a hobby, not as a profession. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Change the voice: 'Never tell a lie.'
options: Let a lie never be told.
Let a lie never was told.
Let a lie never has told.
Let a lie never is told.
questions.explanation: Imperative passive uses 'Let ... be + past participle': Let a lie never be told. (Q39 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: An 'Epic' is
options: songs handed down orally from generation to generation
a long narrative poem based on a myth or legend
questions.explanation: An epic is a long narrative poem about heroic deeds, often based on myth or legend. (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: I ........ rather die than beg.
questions.explanation: 'Would rather ... than' expresses preference. (Q41 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: It is difficult to distinguish ........ the two sisters.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for two people or things. (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: IMPLICATE
questions.explanation: To implicate is to involve in a crime; to exonerate is to declare free from blame. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: STERILE
questions.explanation: Sterile (unable to produce) is the opposite of fertile. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: LOGICAL
questions.explanation: Irrational (not based on reason) is the opposite of logical. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: OMINOUS
questions.explanation: Ominous means threatening or sinister. (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: ENHANCE
questions.explanation: Enhance means to increase or improve. (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: A piece of grassland
questions.explanation: A meadow is a piece of grassland. (Q49 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: A place for keeping birds
questions.explanation: An aviary is a place for keeping birds. (Q50 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: An unmarried man
questions.explanation: A bachelor is an unmarried man. (Q51 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Change the voice: The bell was rung by the chairman.
options: The chairman was ringing the bell.
The chairman had been ringing the bell.
The chairman had rung the bell.
questions.explanation: The active of 'was rung by' is simple past: The chairman rang the bell. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Change the voice: Send this file in.
options: Let this file be sent in.
This file is being sent in.
You are requested to send this file in.
questions.explanation: Imperative passive: Let this file be sent in. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Change the voice: He was praised by his father.
questions.explanation: Past passive becomes simple past active: His father praised him. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Change the voice: He shot the tiger dead.
options: The tiger will be shot dead by him.
Let the tiger be shot dead by him.
It was he who shot the tiger dead.
The tiger was shot dead by him.
questions.explanation: Simple past passive: was + past participle: The tiger was shot dead by him. (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Smell a rat'
questions.explanation: To smell a rat is to suspect something wrong. (Q56 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Out of the wood(s)'
questions.explanation: Out of the wood(s) means out of danger or difficulty. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Cry for the moon'
questions.explanation: To cry for the moon is to ask for the impossible. (Q58 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'Bring to light'
questions.explanation: To bring to light is to disclose or reveal. (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'In black and white'
questions.explanation: In black and white means in writing. (Q60 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-6.html
भाषा समय के साथ बदलती रहती है, अतः परिवर्तनशील है। (Q61 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: ग्रियर्सन के अनुसार भारत में कुल ........ बोलियाँ हैं।
questions.explanation: ग्रियर्सन के भाषा सर्वेक्षण में भारत की 179 भाषाएँ और 544 बोलियाँ बताई गईं। (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: हिन्दी वर्णमाला में (मूल) व्यंजन वर्णों की कुल संख्या ........ है।
questions.explanation: हिन्दी वर्णमाला में मूल व्यंजन 33 हैं (क से ह तक)। (Q63 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: शुद्ध शब्द का चयन करें:
questions.explanation: शुद्ध वर्तनी 'संन्यासी' है (सम् + न्यासी)। (Q64 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: शुद्ध शब्द का चयन कीजिए:
questions.explanation: शुद्ध वर्तनी 'साहित्यिक' है (साहित्य + इक)। (Q65 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: घर बसाकर रहने वाले को ........ कहते हैं।
questions.explanation: घर बसाकर रहने वाले को गृहस्थ कहते हैं। (Q66 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: "उसका अम्बर फट गया" में 'अम्बर ' का क्या अर्थ है?
questions.explanation: यहाँ 'अम्बर' का अर्थ वस्त्र (कपड़ा) है; आकाश वाला अर्थ इस वाक्य में नहीं बैठता। (Q67 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: अ + इ =?
questions.explanation: अ + इ = ए (गुण संधि), जैसे देव + इन्द्र = देवेन्द्र। (Q68 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'कभी' का संधि-विच्छेद होगा:
questions.explanation: कभी = कब + ही। (Q69 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'जिसका' किस सर्वनाम का यौगिक रूप है?
questions.explanation: 'जिसका' संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम 'जो' का विकारी (यौगिक) रूप है। (Q70 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'सुन्दर' विशेषण का स्त्रीलिंग रूप होगा:
questions.explanation: 'सुन्दर' का स्त्रीलिंग 'सुन्दरी' है। (Q71 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'पवित्रता' से विशेषण बनेगा:
questions.explanation: 'पवित्रता' (भाववाचक संज्ञा) का विशेषण 'पवित्र' है। (Q72 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: भविष्यत् काल से किस समय का बोध होता है?
questions.explanation: भविष्यत् काल आने वाले समय का बोध कराता है। (Q73 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'इंदिरा जी एक बार पटना आई थीं' में 'जी' कौन-सा निपात है?
questions.explanation: नाम के साथ 'जी' आदर प्रकट करता है, अतः आदरबोधक निपात। (Q74 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'अनपढ़' का शाब्दिक अर्थ है:
questions.explanation: अनपढ़ = जो पढ़ा-लिखा न हो। (Q75 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'ओजस्वी' का विलोम क्या होगा?

questions.text: रीतिकाल में वीर रस के कवि हैं:

questions.text: निम्न में से कौन-सी पुस्तक महादेवी वर्मा द्वारा लिखित नहीं है?

questions.text: खड़ी बोली का प्रथम महाकाव्य है:

questions.text: विश्वामित्र की तपस्या किसने भंग की?

questions.text: The number which is neither prime nor composite is
questions.textHi: वह संख्या जो न तो अभाज्य है और न ही भाज्य (संयुक्त) है:

questions.text: The reciprocal of −8/9 is

questions.text: What is the product of 3897 and 355?
questions.textHi: 3897 को 355 से गुणा करने पर क्या प्राप्त होगा?

questions.text: If the difference between 7/8 and 3/8 of a property is 112, what is the whole property worth?
questions.textHi: यदि किसी संपत्ति के 7/8वें भाग और 3/8वें भाग के बीच का अंतर 112 है, तो पूरी संपत्ति क्या है?
questions.explanation: (7/8 − 3/8) = 1/2 of the property = 112, so the whole is 224. (Q95 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-10.html
8.014 + 7.700 + 14.050 = 29.764. (Q96 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-10.html

questions.textHi: 40 घंटे 07 मिनट और 38 घंटे 09 मिनट के बीच का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए:

questions.text: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 192 cm. Find the length of one side.
questions.textHi: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का परिमाप 192 सेमी है। इसकी एक भुजा की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Side = 192 ÷ 3 = 64 cm. (Q98 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-10.html

questions.text: Find the missing number: 8, 64, 216, ?, 1000

questions.text: Find the value of 5/6 + 6/5.

questions.text: Find the value of √(√4096 + √1296).
questions.explanation: √4096 = 64 and √1296 = 36; √(64 + 36) = √100 = 10. (Q101 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: Find the compound interest on Rs 12600 for 2 years at 10% per annum.
questions.textHi: 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए 12600 रुपये पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Amount = 12600 × 1.1 × 1.1 = 15246; CI = 15246 − 12600 = Rs 2646. (Q102 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: Find the value of (2x + 5)² − (2x − 5)².
questions.textHi: (2x + 5)² − (2x − 5)² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.text: The marked price of an article is Rs 840. It was sold for Rs 714. Find the discount and the discount per cent.

questions.explanation: Discount = 840 − 714 = Rs 126; 126/840 × 100 = 15%. (Q104 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: Which of the following has the largest value?

questions.text: The length of a rectangle is 5/3 of its breadth. If its perimeter is 80 m, its area is

questions.text: 10 men or 12 women complete a job in 10 days. In how many days will 5 men and 6 women together complete it?
questions.textHi: 10 पुरुष या 12 महिलाएं एक कार्य को 10 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं। 5 पुरुष और 6 महिलाएं मिलकर कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: 10 men = 12 women, so 5 men = 6 women; together they equal 12 women, who need 10 days. (Q108 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-11.html

questions.text: A wire is bent to form a square of side 22 cm. If it is rebent to form a circle, its radius will be

questions.text: The value of (10²² + 10²⁰) / 10²⁰ is

questions.textHi: एक लड़की अपने पिता से 28 वर्ष छोटी है और उनकी आयु का योग 50 वर्ष है, तो लड़की की आयु है:

questions.text: The circumference of a circle whose area is 81πr² is

questions.text: Out of 200 students in a school, 3 out of every 5 like to play cricket. How many students do not like to play cricket?

questions.text: The correct formula of ferric sulphate is

questions.text: The Vivekananda Medical Institute is located at
questions.textHi: विवेकानंद मेडिकल इंस्टीट्यूट कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Vivekananda Medical Institute (Vivekananda Medical Research Trust) is at Palampur, Kangra. (Q139 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: The state of India associated with saffron production is
questions.textHi: केसर उत्पादन से जुड़ा भारत का राज्य है :
questions.explanation: Kashmir (Pampore) is famous for saffron. (Q140 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-14.html

questions.text: Who was the Speaker of the Lok Sabha at the time of the exam (2021)?
questions.textHi: परीक्षा के समय (2021) लोकसभा अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Om Birla has been Lok Sabha Speaker since 2019. (Q141 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Who was the Union Finance Minister at the time of the exam (2021)?
questions.textHi: परीक्षा के समय (2021) केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री कौन थीं?
questions.explanation: Nirmala Sitharaman became Union Finance Minister in 2019. (Q142 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Which of the following awards is given for excellence in sports coaching?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पुरस्कार खेल कोचिंग में उत्कृष्टता के लिए दिया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Dronacharya Award honours excellence in sports coaching. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Which programme was launched by the Government in 2015 keeping female foeticide in mind?
questions.textHi: कन्या भ्रूण हत्या को ध्यान में रखते हुए सरकार द्वारा 2015 में कौन-सा कार्यक्रम शुरू किया गया?
questions.explanation: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched at Panipat on 22 January 2015. (Q144 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Which of these states has the largest number of sugar mills?
questions.textHi: इनमें से किस राज्य में सबसे अधिक चीनी मिलें हैं?
questions.explanation: Among the options, Uttar Pradesh has the most sugar mills. (Q145 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: The AgustaWestland deal was associated with
questions.textHi: अगस्ता वेस्टलैंड सौदा किससे जुड़ा था?
questions.explanation: The AgustaWestland case concerned the purchase of VVIP helicopters. (Q146 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Sriharikota is situated in
questions.textHi: श्रीहरिकोटा कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Sriharikota (Satish Dhawan Space Centre) is in Andhra Pradesh's Tirupati district. (Q147 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: From which city of China did the coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak start?
questions.textHi: कोरोना वायरस (COVID-19) का प्रकोप चीन के किस शहर से शुरू हुआ?
questions.explanation: The COVID-19 outbreak was first reported in Wuhan, Hubei province, in December 2019. (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: How many Rajya Sabha seats does Himachal Pradesh have?
questions.textHi: राज्यसभा में हिमाचल प्रदेश की कितनी सीटें हैं?
questions.explanation: Himachal Pradesh has 3 Rajya Sabha seats (and 4 Lok Sabha seats). (Q149 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Where is the Amazon rainforest located?
questions.textHi: अमेज़न वर्षा वन कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Amazon rainforest is in South America, mostly in Brazil. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-june-2021-paper-part-15.html
